_meta.source: Music Architect V7 — Production Guide Rev 1.0

bpm_buckets.character: Big-room / progressive EDM; dotted-8th delay = 332.1 ms; pre-drop build requires 8-bar riser; sidechain deeply pumped
High-energy EDM border; tighter sidechain (release 208.3 ms); drop impact maximised; PLR target lower end

kick.name: Kick
kick.role: Big-room kick — temporal grid + low-end anchor

effect_chain.params: 18 Hz, 12 dB/oct Butterworth — removes sub-sonic DC
Attack +5 dB, Sustain -4 dB — maximal punch for big-room impact
Ratio 4:1, Thr -12 dBFS, Attack 8 ms, Release 879.1 ms (=2×qn@136.5BPM), Knee 3 dB, GR 3-5 dB
Drive +3-5 dB, Mix 40%, transistor model, THD 5-8%, 2nd-harmonic loudness boost — pre-compressor
Bell -3 dB @300-400 Hz Q=1.4; Bell +3 dB @60 Hz Q=1.2; Shelf +2 dB @4 kHz for click definition
Ceiling -5.0 dBFS, 0.5 dB soft knee, oversampling 4x

bass.name: Bass
bass.role: Wide supersaw sub-bass hybrid — harmonic root

effect_chain.params: 24-30 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Bell +2 dB @fundamental; LFO-filter carve for wobble locked to 60000/BPM/4 ms (16th)
Ratio 6:1, Thr -20 dBFS, Attack 1-2 ms, Release 219.8 ms (=1/8÷2@136.5BPM), GR 5-8 dB
Drive +4-6 dB, Mix 45%, tube+transistor blend, THD 8-12%, post-EQ
7-voice unison wide above 120 Hz; strict mono below 120 Hz (mono-compatibility law)
Ceiling -6.0 dBFS true peak, Lookahead 1.5 ms, Release 100 ms

chords.name: Chords
chords.owns: Low-mid 250-500 Hz + Mid 500 Hz-2 kHz (supersaw wall)

effect_chain.params: Bell -2 dB @800-1200 Hz Q=1.0 (melody pocket); 7-voice detune raises apparent density
Ratio 3:1, Thr -18 dBFS, Attack 15 ms, Release 439.6 ms (=qn@136.5BPM), GR 2-4 dB
Rate 0.5 Hz, Depth 20-30%, Mix 25%, 7-voice supersaw unison
Decay 1.5 s, Pre-delay 27.5 ms (=1/16 frac@136.5BPM), HPF 300 Hz, LPF 7 kHz, Mix 16%
Drive +3 dB, Mix 35%, waveshaper, THD 10-20%, post-EQ pre-reverb

melody.name: Melody
melody.owns: Mid 500 Hz-2 kHz + High-mid 2-8 kHz (supersaw lead)

effect_chain.params: Shelf +3 dB @3 kHz (equal-loudness 2-5 kHz peak); Harmonic stack extends to 8th partial
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -15 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release 293.0 ms (=half-qn@136.5BPM), Knee 6 dB, GR 4-6 dB
Drive +3 dB, Mix 30%, wide unison detune ±25 cents in multiband layer
Time 329.7 ms (dotted-8th@136.5BPM), Feedback 25-35%, HPF 400 Hz, LPF 5 kHz, ping-pong
Decay 1.5 s, Pre-delay 27.5 ms, HPF 400 Hz, LPF 10 kHz, Mix 14%
+2 dB shelf @10 kHz; Ceiling -4 dBFS true peak

arp.name: Arp
arp.role: Wide shimmering arp — rhythmic subdivision carrier

effect_chain.params: Bell +1.5 dB @4-6 kHz Q=1.2; Bell -3 dB @2.9 kHz Q=4 (melody carve)
Ratio 3:1, Attack 3 ms, Release 110.3 ms (=1/16@136.5BPM), GR 3-5 dB
Time 329.7 ms (dotted-8th@136.5BPM), Feedback 22%, HPF 600 Hz — delay throw
Decay 0.6 s (≈0.4× Chords RT60), Pre-delay 13.7 ms, HPF 700 Hz, Mix 10%
Width 70-90% (±60-80%) above 500 Hz; Ceiling -6 dBFS true peak

pads.name: Pads
pads.role: Wide EDM pad wash — ambient harmonic sustain

effect_chain.params: HPF 200-250 Hz 12 dB/oct; LPF 12 kHz 12 dB/oct
Bell -2 dB @1-2 kHz Q=0.8 (Melody clearing); extreme unison detune ±25 cents for width
Ratio 2:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 30 ms, Release 1758.2 ms (=4×qn@136.5BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Rate 0.2-0.4 Hz, Depth 30-50%, Mix 50%, Spread 100%, slow LFO-modulated filter (period=4 bars)
Ratio 3:1, Thr -24 dBFS, Attack 5 ms, Release 879.1 ms (=2×qn@136.5BPM), GR 4-6 dB — EDM deep pump
Decay 5.0 s (longest of all tracks), Pre-delay 54.9 ms, HPF 350 Hz, Mix 30%
Width 80-100% above 200 Hz; strict mono below 120 Hz; Correlation floor +0.1

stabs.name: Stabs
stabs.owns: Mid 500 Hz-6 kHz transients (distorted synth / orchestral hit)

effect_chain.params: Attack +5 dB, Sustain -6 dB — wide dynamic transient for big-room impact
Bell +2 dB @2-3 kHz Q=1.0; saturation THD 15-25% waveshaper
Ratio 4:1, Thr -14 dBFS, Attack 2 ms, Release 219.8 ms (=1/8@136.5BPM), GR 5-8 dB
Decay 0.2-0.4 s, Pre-delay 13.7 ms, HPF 400 Hz, Mix 22%
Haas spread 12 ms side only, Width 120%; Ceiling -5 dBFS

fx.name: FX
fx.owns: Air 2 kHz-20 kHz + sub-drop + broadband sweeps
fx.role: Big riser / sub-drop / pre-drop tension builder

effect_chain.params: HPF sweep 80 Hz→4 kHz over final build bar; sub-drop: sine 80→20 Hz; riser: noise+tonal hybrid
Bell -3 dB where overlapping Melody/Lead, Q=1.5
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -28 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release 879.1 ms (=2×qn@136.5BPM), GR 3-5 dB
Decay ≥5.0 s (≥Pads RT60), Pre-delay 27.5 ms, HPF 500 Hz, Mix 50%
Width 90-100% (mid-side); maximal enveloping character for drops
Ceiling -8 dBFS; LPF 16 kHz 12 dB/oct
300-500 Hz, 12 dB/oct; saturated/parallel-compressed for drop energy
Attack +3 dB, Sustain -5 dB — aggressive snap for drop-section energy
Ratio 4:1, Attack 1 ms, Release 110.3 ms (=1/16@136.5BPM), GR 3-5 dB
Shelf +2 dB @8 kHz, 6 dB/oct; Bell -3 dB @6.3 kHz Q=2.5 (sharpness control)
Decay 0.3-0.5 s (room-verb tail for big-room width), Pre-delay 13.7 ms, HPF 800 Hz, Mix 15%
Width 50-80% above 800 Hz, Pan spread ±50-80%; Drive +2 dB, Mix 30%, transistor
Sweeps from 400 Hz→20 Hz over 8 bars (14.07 s at 136.5 BPM); 24 dB/oct
Bell -2 dB where borrowed tracks overlap, Q=1.0
Ratio 2:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 20 ms, Release 879.1 ms (=2×qn@136.5BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Decay 5.0 s, Pre-delay 54.9 ms, wet% ramps down as intro progresses
Ceiling -8 dBFS true peak

drum.chain: EQ (HPF 25 Hz) -> Comp (4:1, 3 ms attack, aggressive) -> Saturation (transistor, 5-8% THD) -> Parallel Comp Return

bass.chain: EQ (mono-below-120, resonance carve for wobble) -> Comp (6:1) -> Saturation (tube+transistor blend, 8-12% THD)

synth.chain: EQ (broad carve) -> Comp (2.5:1, glue) -> Stereo Widener (mid-side, wide)

master.chain: EQ (tonal balance) -> Bus Comp (2.5:1, 15 ms attack, 3-4 dB max GR) -> Saturation (1% THD) -> Limiter (True Peak -1.0 dBTP)

parallel_compression.release_formula: 40-70 ms (very short — aggressive EDM drop impact)
parallel_compression.reasoning: Massive 35-50% wet blend with extreme ratio/GR achieves EDM's signature wall-of-sound loudness; very short release (40-70 ms) maximises transient impact at the drop.

kick.exclusive_claim: 50-70 Hz peak; wide-band layering (30 Hz sub + 3 kHz click) maximises loudness.

bass.exclusive_claim: Mono below 120 Hz; 7-voice unison width above 120 Hz.

chords.exclusive_claim: Supersaw density; pluck chords 150-250 ms decay to avoid Pad overlap.

melody.exclusive_claim: 2-8 kHz priority for drop impact; harmonic stack extends to 8th partial.

arp.exclusive_claim: 3-6 kHz shimmering arp; -3 dB notch at melody presence peak.

pads.exclusive_claim: Extreme width ±25 cents unison; LFO-modulated 4-bar filter sweep.

stabs.exclusive_claim: Time-sliced: <15% duty cycle per bar; waveshaper THD 10-20%.

fx.exclusive_claim: Riser sweep 80 Hz→4 kHz; sub-drop 80→20 Hz sine; maximal pre-drop tension.

percussion.exclusive_claim: Saturated/parallel-compressed hats for drop energy; big-room clap wide.

intro.exclusive_claim: 8-bar build; HPF sweep creates classic EDM riser effect.

streaming.notes: Platform-normalised on ingest. M/S mastering mandatory: side HPF 200 Hz, side shelf +1.5-2.5 dB @8 kHz. Stem naming: edm_gen{N}_seed_{id}_{track}_v{ver}.wav

broadcast.notes: EBU R128 ±0.5 LU tolerance; anything outside is rejected at ingest.

sync_licensing.notes: Stems mandatory. Instrumental and vocal stem splits required. M/S insert mandatory per Section H EDM spec.

branches.kick_desc: Pure sine sub kick — minimal techno / deep EDM variant
Hybrid processed big-room kick — primary EDM default (D2 = rich partials, THD 10-20%)

bass.avoid: D2-D3 at R1 (intermodulation risk — EDM bass already D2)

chords.avoid: D3 (adds third dense-partial source — IMD products ∝ n²)

arp.avoid: D2-D3 (fourth dense layer risks IMD product density)

branches.kick_desc: Dark slow-attack sub kick — breakdown / atmospheric EDM section

bass.avoid: A2-A3 (two slow-attack low elements erase transient anchor)

chords.codes: B1-B3, any D, any A, R1-R2

arp.avoid: A2-A3 (slow arp defeats EDM rhythmic arp purpose)
